# Pull Request

## Summary

- Describe the change in 1-3 bullets.

## Why

Describe the problem this change solves and the user impact.

## Test Plan

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] App opened at `http://127.0.0.1:5177`
- [ ] Relevant browser workflow verified

## Media Workflow Checks

- [ ] Decode path checked
- [ ] Estimate or manual sync path checked
- [ ] Preview path checked
- [ ] Export path checked, if touched

## Screenshots or Clips

Add before and after screenshots for UI changes.
